relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a 14-year-old boy carrying "a novel de novo heterozygous 2 bp deletion in tumour necrosis factor-alpha-induced protein 3 (TNFAIP3" (c.1466_1467delTG, p.V489Afs*7) with early-onset autoimmune disease.
method_note: Read the paper directly; JSON assembled by a short Python script in the scratch directory (no table transcribed automatically; Table 1 values were quoted by hand and every span checked verbatim by script). Table 1 columns are time points (Pretransplant, Post-transplant, Reference range), not patients; table spans quote from the row label through the cited cell(s). Individuals: the index patient ('patient') and 'first-born infant' (pedigree legend: died of prematurity; not described as tested or affected). The parents ('healthy non-consanguineous British parents') and 'healthy unaffected siblings' (number not given) are described only collectively, so no rows were created. Inconsistencies/notes: (1) the variant is printed as 'c.1466_1467TGdel' and 'V489Afs*7' in the Figure 1 legend but 'c.1466_1467delTG' and 'p.V489Afs*7' in the main text; main-text forms recorded. (2) The authors call the variant 'de novo' but do not describe parental testing, so under rule 8 inheritance and parental_testing_statement are 'not reported'. (3) Table 1 gives a leucocyte reference range of '150–450' against values 1.88/3.47 x10^9/L, and a post-transplant CD4+ naive value of '244' (%), both implausible as printed; not used. (4) Pretransplant haemoglobin 9.8 g/dL, platelets 29 and neutrophils 1.52 (G-CSF supported) lie below the printed reference ranges, but the authors do not name these as separate features; only the narrative 'cytopaenias' was recorded. (5) '14-year-old' is recorded as age at last evaluation (age at report/investigation); the paper does not separately state age at diagnosis. (6) 'enteropathy' and 'hepatitis' are mapped to the checklist items 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' and 'autoimmune hepatitis' because the authors list them as features of 'complex autoimmunity'; 'cytopaenias' likewise to 'cytopenia (autoimmune)'. pANCA was detected but no vasculitis is stated, so vasculitis is 'not reported'.

The c.1466_1467delTG variant—which we confirmed by capillary sequencing10 (figure 1B)
Pathogenic variants in STAT3 and FOXP3 were excluded
we performed functional experiments in patient and control dermal fibroblasts

span: V489Afs*7 reduced basal and TNF-induced A20 protein in patient (P) versus control (C1, C2) fibroblasts
We observed exaggerated and prolonged phosphorylation of components of the NF-κB pathway
RNA sequencing (Illumina NextSeq-500) revealed a significant global increase in both the range and magnitude of TNF-α-stimulated differential gene expression
We also confirmed enhanced expression of the key NF-κB target gene interleukin 6 (IL-6) at the protein level by ELISA (p=0.0015, figure 1G)
owing to the lack of leucocyte material, we were not able to extend our analysis to inflammasome activation
